scripts.build:android: rm -rf android/app/build/generated/assets android/app/build/intermediates/assets android/app/build/intermediates/compressed_assets android/app/build/intermediates/merged_assets && JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk-21.jdk/Contents/Home ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease && echo "\nAPK: $(pwd)/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
scripts.build:android-debug: rm -rf android/app/build/generated/assets android/app/build/intermediates/assets android/app/build/intermediates/compressed_assets android/app/build/intermediates/merged_assets && JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk-21.jdk/Contents/Home ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug && echo "\nAPK: $(pwd)/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -workspace ios/encatchexpotester.xcworkspace -scheme encatchexpotester -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath ios/build/encatchexpotester.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/encatchexpotester.xcarchive -exportPath ios/build/ipa -exportOptionsPlist ios/exportOptions.plist
